# Callahan & Blaine

> A premier California trial law firm specializing in complex business litigation, insurance disputes, and personal injury representation across Southern California.

Callahan & Blaine is a full-service litigation firm based in Orange County with expertise in defending complex commercial disputes, insurance claims, employment matters, and personal injury cases. The firm serves clients throughout Southern California including Orange County, Los Angeles, and the Central District of California.

- [Orange County Insurance Litigation Lawyer | Callahan & Blaine](https://www.callahan-law.com/insurance-litigation): Insurance litigation services including bad-faith claims and coverage disputes.
- [Personal Injury Lawyer in Orange County | Callahan & Blaine](https://www.callahan-law.com/personal-injury): Personal injury representation for catastrophic injuries and wrongful death.
- [Employment Defense Lawyer in Orange County | Callahan & Blaine](https://www.callahan-law.com/employment-law): Employment litigation defense for discrimination and wrongful termination.
- [Orange County Professional Liability Attorney | Callahan & Blaine](https://www.callahan-law.com/practice-areas/professional-liability): Professional liability and malpractice representation in Orange County.
- [Orange County Transactional & Corporate Attorney | Callahan & Blaine](https://www.callahan-law.com/practice-areas/transactional-and-corporate-law): Transactional and corporate law services for business transactions and disputes.
